results.controlIntent: Use [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] to: (a) Document proposed changes to the system; (b) Notify [Assignment: organization-defined approval authorities] of proposed changes to the system and request change approval; (c) Highlight proposed changes to the system that have not been approved or disapproved within [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; (d) Prohibit changes to the system until designated approvals are received; (e) Document all changes to the system; and (f) Notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel] when approved changes to the system are completed.

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two collector tools reveals multiple failures against CM-3(1):

**CM-3(1)(d) — Prohibit changes until designated approvals are received:**
- The initial CreateEndpoint event (2025-12-01T11:00:00Z, evidence ID 1196c8f4) occurred *after* the registry approval timestamp (2025-12-01T09:00:00Z, evidence ID b1aa20d0), so the first deployment technically followed approval in temporal order.
- However, the UpdateEndpoint / hotfix event (2026-03-15T14:22:00Z, evidence ID 2aa39f1d) has **no corresponding model registry entry**. This means a production change was deployed without any documented approval in the model registry — a direct violation of the "prohibit changes until approvals are received" requirement.

**CM-3(1)(a),(b),(e) — Document and notify for proposed/completed changes:**
- The hotfix deployment (2aa39f1d) has no registry entry, meaning the change was neither documented as a proposed change nor formally approved before deployment.
- There is no evidence of automated notification mechanisms alerting approval authorities of proposed changes or notifying personnel upon completion.

**CM-3(1)(c),(f) — Highlight unapproved changes / notify on completion:**
- No evidence of any automated mechanism that flags pending or unapproved changes, or that sends completion notifications to designated personnel.

In summary, at least one production change (the hotfix) bypassed the change-control gate entirely, and there is no evidence of the broader automated notification and documentation mechanisms required by this control.
gaps: No evidence of an automated notification mechanism alerting approval authorities of proposed changes (CM-3(1)(b))
No evidence of automated highlighting/escalation of changes pending approval beyond a defined time period (CM-3(1)(c))
No evidence of automated completion notifications to designated personnel (CM-3(1)(f))
No registry entry or approval record for the 2026-03-15 hotfix deployment — human attestation needed to determine whether an out-of-band approval process exists
No evidence of a policy-enforced gate (e.g., IAM condition, SageMaker pipeline gate) that technically prevents deployment without registry approval

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
